name: get_remaining_spawn_group_object_count

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_GetRemainingSpawnGroupObjectCount replaces the top spawn-group ID with the result of func_0014E710

notes: func_0014E710 iterates scene spawn records through func_00131F58, selects records whose group field at offset 0x58 equals the argument, and counts records not marked complete. A registered object counts while its completion flag at object offset 0x370 is clear; an absent object counts unless func_00142478 reports persistent state 1 for its object ID. The same group field selects bits in the spawn-group enable mask D_00553BEC. The JP corpus contains 25 calls across al02.ard, ew22.ard, and ew23.ard; every result is immediately stored, and the retained values drive zero/nonzero battle-progress branches. Calls use group IDs 1 through 5, and the nine variable-ID calls in ew23.ard first enable the same group through command 361.
